## Report

Built the **hot authoring-state index** (workstream E), three new files, no edits to any sibling system.

### Files created
- `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/editor/hot_index.zig` — host-side live working set. `HotIndex` holds: by-id object map (id → {kind, occupied chunks}), by-chunk reverse index (chunk → object-id set), selection set, dirty-ids + dirty-chunks sets, and per-chunk baked signatures. `observe(seq, envelope_json)` parses the envelope's `targets`, unions `chunk` refs directly (id `"cx,cz"`), and resolves object refs to chunks **via the by-id entry** (O(occupied-chunks-of-that-object), never a world scan), re-homing placed objects between buckets. Exposes `summaryJson()` (counts only), selection/dirty mutators, `markBaked`, `removeObject`, and a `last_observe_work` debug counter that bounds the per-fold work. Process-wide singleton via `instance()`. Reuses `world_chunk_dirty` (ChunkCoord, chunkOfTile) and `world_compile_cache` (Hash).
- `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/editor/v8_bindings_hot_index.zig` — read-only React door `__editor_index_summary()` plus `__editor_index_select/deselect/clear_selection/selected_count`. All operate on the same singleton the bus folds into.
- `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/framework/testing/unit/hot_index.zig` — 9 tests incl. chunk-target dirties exactly that chunk, object-target resolves its chunk via the index, re-home, removeObject, summary/selection, markBaked, malformed-envelope no-op, and the **SCALING** test (pre-load 20k objects, assert one `observe` keeps `last_observe_work < 16`). Uses `testing.allocator` for leak detection. Not run (per instructions).

### Exact integration lines

**The bus hook** (one line in `framework/events/editor_bus.zig::append()`, right after the existing broadcast near the end):
```zig
        if (g_broadcaster) |bc| bc(confirmed);
        @import("../editor/hot_index.zig").instance().observe(seq, confirmed); // ← ADD
        return seq;
```
`confirmed` stays valid (freed only on ring eviction); `observe` re-parses independently and never frees it, returns a `bool` the bus ignores. A function-pointer alternative is documented in the file if editor_bus prefers no `editor/` import.

**v8_ingredients.zig** (always-on block, after the `editor_bus` entry):
```zig
const v8_bindings_hot_index = @import("editor/v8_bindings_hot_index.zig");
.{ .name = "hot_index", .required = true, .grep_prefix = "", .reg_fn = "registerHotIndex", .mod = v8_bindings_hot_index },
```

**build.zig test wiring** — mirrors the `world_gamefile_writer_test` block; provides `world_compile_cache` + `world_chunk_dirty` modules to BOTH the index module and the test module, then a `test-hot-index` step. Full block is in the `// INTEGRATION:` header of both `v8_bindings_hot_index.zig` and the test file. No production build.zig change needed (root reaches `hot_index.zig` transitively via relative import).

### ast-check
All three files pass `zig ast-check` (zig at `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/zig`).

### Contract notes
- Seam 1 honored: an edit's cost is independent of map size; the scaling test is the gate.
- One wording nuance in the brief — "resolve object refs via the by-chunk index" — would be backwards if taken literally (that's chunk→objects). Object→chunk resolution is done via the by-id entry's stored chunk membership, which is the O(1) spatial resolver; the by-chunk index is the reverse view for selection/queries. Documented in the module header. No other contract gaps.</result>
